text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Admin time dropped. Reps got back roughly four hours a week they used to spend typing CRM updates after visits.

Adoption followed trust. Reps pushed back until we let them review and edit summaries before anything synced.

Better notes meant better handoffs. Sales engineers and customer success finally saw what was actually promised.

Not everything worked. Noisy job sites and heavy accents hurt accuracy, so we kept manual backups.

The biggest lesson: the tool didn't make reps better sellers. It gave them time to be one.

Next up: two more regions in January, plus spot-checks.

What would you measure in your own pilot?
